name: Keychron V1 Max Mechanical Keyboard
description: A customizable compact keyboard with a gasket-mounted design for a comfortable, quiet typing feel. Connect to multiple devices wirelessly or use USB-C for a dependable wired setup.

name: Logitech MX Mechanical Mini
description: This low-profile wireless keyboard brings a precise mechanical typing experience to a compact desk setup. Smart illumination and multi-device pairing make it easy to work across computers.

name: Anker 555 USB-C Hub (8-in-1)

specs.Ports: 2 USB-A, USB-C data, HDMI, Ethernet, SD, microSD

description: Expand a USB-C laptop with display, networking, card-reader, and USB connections in one travel-ready hub. Its pass-through charging port keeps your workstation powered while the hub is in use.

name: CalDigit TS4 Thunderbolt Station
description: Build a powerful single-cable workstation with high-speed storage, display, and peripheral connections. The dock supports up to 98 W of host charging and includes a broad range of front and rear ports.

name: Satechi USB4 NVMe SSD Enclosure
description: Turn a compatible M.2 NVMe drive into a fast portable SSD for project files and backups. Its aluminum enclosure helps dissipate heat during sustained transfers.

name: Samsung 990 PRO 2TB NVMe SSD
description: Speed up builds, large file transfers, and game loads with a high-performance PCIe 4.0 drive. The 2 TB capacity provides room for active projects and frequently used applications.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse
description: Work comfortably through long coding sessions with an ergonomic shape and a precision thumb wheel. The quiet clicks and high-resolution sensor work well across a variety of surfaces.

name: ASUS ZenScreen MB16ACV Portable Monitor
description: Add a lightweight second screen to a laptop setup at home, in the office, or on the road. A single USB-C connection carries the display signal and power on compatible devices.

name: BenQ ScreenBar Halo 2 Monitor Light

specs.Lighting: Front task light and rear bias light

description: Balance focused desk lighting with a soft ambient glow behind your display. The wireless dial makes brightness and color temperature easy to adjust.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
description: Focus in busy workspaces with adaptive noise canceling and comfortable over-ear cushions. Multipoint Bluetooth and clear voice pickup make switching between calls and devices straightforward.

name: Elgato Facecam MK.2
description: Bring a sharp, natural-looking image to video calls, streaming, and remote presentations. Camera Hub software provides manual controls for exposure, white balance, and field of view.

name: Jabra Evolve2 65 Flex
description: A foldable wireless headset designed for clear meetings and focused work in changing environments. The retractable boom microphone and included charging pad support a tidy everyday setup.

name: Keychron Q1 HE Wireless Custom Keyboard
description: A premium aluminum keyboard with adjustable magnetic switches for a highly personalized typing feel. Set actuation points and rapid trigger behavior to match your workflow.

name: OWC Thunderbolt Go Dock
description: Connect displays, storage, and accessories through one compact Thunderbolt dock with its power supply built in. It delivers up to 90 W to a compatible host laptop.

name: Crucial X10 Pro 2TB Portable SSD
description: Carry project files in a compact solid-state drive built for quick transfers on the go. Its rugged enclosure is designed to handle dust, splashes, and everyday travel.

name: Logitech Lift Vertical Ergonomic Mouse
description: A softly contoured vertical mouse that supports a more natural hand position for smaller and medium hands. Quiet clicks and multi-device pairing suit focused desk work.

name: Kensington Expert Wireless Trackball
description: Navigate a desktop precisely while keeping your hand comfortably in one place. A large ball and detachable scroll ring make the trackball easy to tailor to your setup.

name: Dell UltraSharp U2724DE 27-inch Monitor
description: A sharp 27-inch QHD display with a high refresh rate for detailed work and smooth everyday motion. Its integrated Thunderbolt hub helps simplify a modern desk connection.
